linesEn: Whoa, look at the size of this cavern!

linesZhTw: 還真想不到瀑布後面會有
linesZhCn: 还真想不到瀑布后面会有
linesEn: Without that tip, who'd have guessed
such a massive place was hidden
right behind a waterfall?

linesZhTw: 情查清楚了，禁衛軍統領
葛雷和敵方勾結，他想謀
linesZhCn: 情查清楚了，禁卫军统领
葛雷和敌方勾结，他想谋
linesEn: Your Highness, I have uncovered the truth.
Gray, Commander of the Royal Guard, colluded
with the enemy. He intended to...

linesZhTw: 事實上，陛下在那一晚遇
襲時就已經被擒走了，之
linesZhCn: 事实上，陛下在那一晚遇
袭时就已经被擒走了，之
linesEn: ...assassinate His Majesty and take the throne.
In truth, the King was captured on the very
night of the ambush. After that...

linesZhTw: 後葛雷就偽稱陛下在寢宮
中養傷，然後假借陛下的
linesZhCn: 后葛雷就伪称陛下在寝宫
中养伤，然后假借陛下的
linesEn: ...Gray falsely claimed His Majesty was recovering
in his bedchambers, issuing orders
under the King's royal name.

linesZhTw: 國軍的機會，利用你們把
linesZhCn: 国军的机会，利用你们把
linesEn: And he tried to take advantage of our clash
with the army, using you to eliminate me,
so that afterward, he could...
...sit on his stolen throne without a worry.

linesZhTw: 雷的一名手下曾替他傳遞
信件到此地，我們才能找
linesZhCn: 雷的一名手下曾替他传递
信件到此地，我们才能找
linesEn: It is entirely my fault for being so blind.
Fortunately, one of Gray's lackeys carried
a message here, allowing us to...

linesZhTw: 到這個所在，相信陛下可
linesZhCn: 到这个所在，相信陛下可
linesEn: ...track down this hideout. I believe
His Majesty is being held captive here.

linesZhTw: 那個作怪的傢伙找出來痛
打一頓，這件事就可以做
linesZhCn: 那个作怪的家伙找出来痛
打一顿，这件事就可以做
linesEn: Then what are we waiting for?! Let's track down
the troublemaker, beat him to a pulp,
and then...
...we can put an end to this whole mess!
Reckless fools who know nothing of death!
You truly are hopelessly naive!

linesZhTw: 快把陛下交還給我們，不
然王國禁衛軍是不會放過
linesZhCn: 快把陛下交还给我们，不
然王国禁卫军是不会放过
linesEn: So you're the mastermind behind all this?!
Release His Majesty at once, or the Royal Guard
will never let you get away with this!
We will show you no mercy!

linesZhTw: 你們送上西天，我會讓他
linesZhCn: 你们送上西天，我会让他
linesEn: You mean that old fossil Canaan III?
Don't worry. Once I send you all to your graves,
I'll make sure he...
...joins you in the afterlife soon enough!
Bwahahaha!
Hmph! You ugly fiend, try backing up
that big talk in battle first!
The enemy is numerous! Stay sharp, everyone!
Reinforcements will be here shortly, so...
...fight within your limits,
and don't take reckless risks!

linesZhTw: 你們一個都別想活著出去
linesZhCn: 你们一个都别想活着出去
linesEn: Come at me with everything you've got!
Not a single one of you leaves this cave alive!
Bwahahaha!
Sir Raiden! Forgive our late arrival,
we deserve whatever punishment...

linesZhTw: 禁在此，憑著王國禁衛軍的
linesZhCn: 禁在此，凭着王国禁卫军的
linesEn: No matter! His Majesty is indeed imprisoned here!
On the honor of the Royal Guard, fight bravely
and bring His Majesty back safely!
Rescue the King, at all costs!
By your command!

linesZhTw: 想的還難繼，不過我沒有耐
linesZhCn: 想的还难继，不过我没有耐
linesEn: I must admit, you're tougher than I expected.
However, I have no patience left to play
these games with you.
Minions, execute Canaan III!

linesZhTw: 你們這些無名小卒給打敗了
linesZhCn: 你们这些无名小卒给打败了
linesEn: ...I-Impossible... Defeated by a band
of nobodies like you...?!
...Master... save me...!

linesZhTw: 綁架國王、惹起這一切事端
linesZhCn: 绑架国王、惹起这一切事端
linesEn: Save your breath! Speak! What was your goal
in abducting the King and causing
all this chaos?!
...To... to seize the royal treasure,
the Golden Emblem... It is...
It's what?! Spit it out!
...The key... to the flying chariot...
Aaaargh...!
Father! You're safe!
I was so worried...!

linesZhTw: 這可要多謝妳的朋友們，
linesZhCn: 这可要多谢你的朋友们，
linesEn: Fret not, my sweet child. I am unharmed.
I owe it all to your friends here...

linesZhTw: 不然這回我真的是難逃劫數
linesZhCn: 不然这回我真的是难逃劫数
linesEn: ...Otherwise, I truly would have perished.
Your Majesty, what baffles us is why the enemy
targeted you in the first place.
Do you know the reason?
Put simply, they came for the royal treasure,
the Golden Emblem.
The Golden Emblem? What's that?

linesZhTw: 黃金徽章是亞克斯王家的祖
傳之寶，據說它有著莫大的
linesZhCn: 黄金徽章是亚克斯王家的祖
传之宝，据说它有着莫大的
linesEn: Allow me to explain. The Golden Emblem is
an ancestral heirloom of the royal house of Axe.
It is said to possess immense, mystical power...

linesZhTw: 神秘力量，所以幾代以來都
一直小心的收藏著，但是它
究竟有什麼功用，也一直都
linesZhCn: 神秘力量，所以几代以来都
一直小心的收藏着，但是它
究竟有什么功用，也一直都
linesEn: ...and has been carefully preserved for generations.
Yet as to what purpose it actually serves,
to this day...
...no one truly knows.

linesZhTw: 就是要逼我交出黃金徽章。
後來我被拷問得受不了了，
linesZhCn: 就是要逼我交出黄金徽章。
后来我被拷问得受不了了，
linesEn: They dragged me here to force me
to surrender the Golden Emblem.
Under relentless torture...

linesZhTw: 終於告訴他們黃金徽章的所
在，還連累了執掌神殿的索
linesZhCn: 终于告诉他们黄金徽章的所
在，还连累了执掌神殿的索
linesEn: ...I broke and gave away the emblem's location,
dragging Sophia and the temple into harm's way...
I see. So Jonah foresaw correctly after all...
Sage Jonah? You know him?

linesZhTw: 是他要我到王城和他碰面，
linesZhCn: 是他要我到王城和他碰面，
linesEn: We are old friends. In fact, he was the one
who asked me to meet him in the royal capital,
which is how I ended up caught up in this.

linesZhTw: 說幾天後會有一個朋友來王
城找他，希望我能把黃金徽
linesZhCn: 说几天后会有一个朋友来王
城找他，希望我能把黄金徽
linesEn: He came to see me a few days ago as well.
He mentioned that a friend would be arriving soon,
and asked if I could lend the Golden Emblem...

linesZhTw: 章借給他，看來他說的就是
linesZhCn: 章借给他，看来他说的就是
linesEn: ...It seems you were the friend he spoke of.
So you truly have met Jonah! In that case...
regarding the Golden Emblem,
would you agree to lend it?
That rests entirely on His Majesty's decision...

linesZhTw: 約拿的大名，他要借用黃金
徽章，一定是有重要的用途
linesZhCn: 约拿的大名，他要借用黄金
徽章，一定是有重要的用途
linesEn: Think nothing of it. I have long heard of
Sage Jonah's great renown. If he asks for it,
he must have an urgent purpose.
Sophia, once we return to the capital,
deliver the Golden Emblem into his hands.
Your Majesty, I have a request of my own.
I hope you will grant your blessing as well...
What request would that be?

linesZhTw: 徒正在進行一樁陰謀，他自
己先動身去調查此事，但希
望我也能前去幫忙，貢獻我
linesZhCn: 徒正在进行一桩阴谋，他自
己先动身去调查此事，但希
望我也能前去帮忙，贡献我
linesEn: According to Jonah, a wicked cabal is hatching
a sinister plot. He set out ahead to investigate,
and asked that I join him to offer my devotion

linesZhTw: 自己對神的虔誠與神聖的力
linesZhCn: 自己对神的虔诚与神圣的力
linesEn: and sacred power in halting their evil deeds.

linesZhTw: 所以我可能不能再擔任神殿
司祭一職，請陛下您答應……』
linesZhCn: 所以我可能不能再担任神殿
司祭一职，请陛下您答应……』
linesEn: Thus, I must step down as priestess of the temple.
Your Majesty, please grant me permission...
Is that so? Very well, I will not stand in your way.
Go with my blessing, and take good care!
I am deeply grateful! May the Holy Spirit
watch over Your Majesty!
Father, I also have a request...
Celia, don't tell me you wish to...

linesZhTw: 些朋友們一起冒險，覺得自
己長大了不少。如今邪徒的
linesZhCn: 些朋友们一起冒险，觉得自
己长大了不少。如今邪徒的
linesEn: Father, traveling with these friends these past days
has made me feel so much more mature. Now that
this sinister plot threatens our kingdom of Axe...

linesZhTw: 陰謀已經威脅到我們亞克斯
王國，我身為王國第一公主
跟著他們去冒險，多少也可
linesZhCn: 阴谋已经威胁到我们亚克斯
王国，我身为王国第一公主
跟着他们去冒险，多少也可
linesEn: ...as First Princess, going along on this quest
is a way for me to shoulder my responsibility...
...and do my part for our people.

linesZhTw: 這些天來吃了不少苦吧？』
linesZhCn: 这些天来吃了不少苦吧？』
linesEn: ...Celia, you've grown thin. You must have endured
much hardship out there.

linesZhTw: 和敵人戰鬥時，索爾和亞雷
linesZhCn: 和敌人战斗时，索尔和亚雷
linesEn: Not at all! Everyone has been so kind to me.
Whenever we fought, Thor and Ares always jumped
in front of me to protect me...
...so that I never came to harm.

linesZhTw: 多謝你們照顧我的女兒，
linesZhCn: 多谢你们照顾我的女儿，
linesEn: Is that so? Thor, Ares, you have my deepest thanks
for watching over my daughter. If time permitted...

linesZhTw: 希望能有機會好好謝謝你們
linesZhCn: 希望能有机会好好谢谢你们
linesEn: ...I would reward you properly for your valor.
Thank you, Your Majesty. You do us too much honor.
Yeah! To be honest, we had no idea
Celia was actually a princess...

linesZhTw: 功夫還真到家。我答應妳的
請求，不過為了妳的安全起
linesZhCn: 功夫还真到家。我答应你的
请求，不过为了你的安全起
linesEn: Hahaha! Celia, you certainly know how to keep a secret.
I grant your request. However, for your safety...

linesZhTw: 見，由禁衛隊長萊汀與妳隨
linesZhCn: 见，由禁卫队长莱汀与你随
linesEn: ...Captain Raiden of the Royal Guard will accompany you.
You have no objections, I presume?
None at all! Thank you so much, Father!
I shall protect the Princess with my very life.
Rest easy, Your Majesty.

linesZhTw: 城中再說，我們趕快離開這
linesZhCn: 城中再说，我们赶快离开这
linesEn: Excellent! We can discuss the rest back at the castle.
Let us make haste out of this dreary cavern!

linesZhTw: 『屬下這就安排禁衛軍前來迎
linesZhCn: 『属下这就安排禁卫军前来迎
linesEn: I shall send word for an escort at once.
Everyone, let us depart!

linesZhTw: 索爾，這場熱鬧我們還要繼
linesZhCn: 索尔，这场热闹我们还要继
linesEn: Looks like things are spiraling into something huge.
Thor, are we really going to keep throwing ourselves
into the middle of all this?

linesZhTw: 治好悠妮的失憶症再說。
linesZhCn: 治好悠妮的失忆症再说。
linesEn: No matter what, we have to find Sage Jonah
and cure Uni's amnesia first.
Ares, you're with me, right?
Do you even have to ask? Let's move!
